# Nicolas Boizard

> Member of Technical Staff on the pretraining team at Cohere, scaling up model training, and PhD candidate at CentraleSupélec (Université Paris-Saclay), advised by Pierre Colombo and Céline Hudelot, defending in early 2027. PhD research on large-scale training of multilingual and multimodal LLMs, both decoders and encoders (EuroLLM, CroissantLLM, BidirLM-Omni, EuroBERT), and on distillation, such as the Universal Logit Distillation Loss for cross-tokenizer distillation.

Machine-readable copies of everything on this site: [timeline.json](https://nicolas-bzrd.github.io/data/timeline.json) (all entries, structured), [publications.md](https://nicolas-bzrd.github.io/publications.md) (full abstracts, plain text). The home page also embeds schema.org JSON-LD (`ProfilePage`, `Person`, `ScholarlyArticle`).

## Publications

- [BidirLM: From Text to Omnimodal Bidirectional Encoders by Adapting and Composing Causal LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02045): 2026 — COLM 2026. N Boizard, T Deschamps-Berger, H Gisserot-Boukhlef, C Hudelot, P Colombo
- [BERT-as-a-Judge: A Robust Alternative to Lexical Methods for Efficient Reference-Based LLM Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.09497): 2026 — COLM 2026. H Gisserot-Boukhlef, N Boizard, E Malherbe, C Hudelot, P Colombo
- [EuroLLM-22B: Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.05879): 2026 — Technical Report. MM Ramos, DM Alves, H Gisserot-Boukhlef, J Alves, PH Martins, ...
- [Scale or Reason? A Compute-Equivalent Analysis of Reasoning Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22193): 2025 — EMNLP 2026. N Boizard, H Gisserot-Boukhlef, K El Haddad, C Hudelot, P Colombo
- [Should We Still Pretrain Encoders with Masked Language Modeling?](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.00994): 2025 — ICLR 2026. H Gisserot-Boukhlef, N Boizard, M Faysse, DM Alves, E Malherbe, ...
- [EuroLLM-9B: Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.04079): 2025 — Technical Report. PH Martins, J Alves, P Fernandes, NM Guerreiro, R Rei, A Farajian, ...
- [EuroBERT: Scaling Multilingual Encoders for European Languages](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.05500): 2025 — COLM 2025. N Boizard, H Gisserot-Boukhlef, DM Alves, A Martins, A Hammal, C Corro, ...
- [Towards cross-tokenizer distillation: the universal logit distillation loss for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.12030): 2024 — TMLR 2025. N Boizard, K El Haddad, C Hudelot, P Colombo
- [Croissantllm: A truly bilingual french-english language model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.00786): 2024 — TMLR 2025. M Faysse, P Fernandes, N Guerreiro, A Loison, D Alves, C Corro, ...
- [Deep learning-based stereo camera multi-video synchronization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.12916): 2023 — ICASSP 2023. N Boizard, K El Haddad, T Ravet, F Cresson, T Dutoit
